payload.name: Finanse.app
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Finanse to aplikacja do wspólnego budżetu dla osób i rodzin. Jedno połączenie obejmuje wszystkie Twoje projekty budżetowe — możesz zapytać o bieżący albo wskazać inny po nazwie. Zapytaj, na co poszły pieniądze w danym miesiącu, jak wygląda podział na kategorie, czy mieścisz się w budżetach, jak zmieniało się saldo, ile możesz bezpiecznie wydać do końca miesiąca i jakie stałe płatności są przed Tobą — odpowiedzi pojawiają się jako czytelne karty, nie ściany tekstu. Możesz zapisać wydatek lub przychód, kilka naraz albo cały paragon podzielony na kategorie, ustawić płatność cykliczną i śledzić cele oszczędnościowe. Zmiany, usunięcia i paragony zawsze pokazują podgląd do zatwierdzenia, zanim cokolwiek się zmieni. Finanse zapisuje transakcje, które już się wydarzyły — nie przelewa pieniędzy, nie łączy się z bankiem i nie prosi o dane karty.

Finanse is a shared budget app for individuals and families. One connection covers all of your budget projects — ask about the current one or name another. Ask where the money went in a given month, how it split across categories, whether you are inside your budgets, how your balance moved, how much is safe to spend until the month ends and which recurring payments are coming up — answers come back as readable cards rather than walls of text. You can record an expense or income, several at once, or a whole shop receipt split into categories, set up a recurring payment and track savings goals. Edits, deletions and receipts always show a preview you approve before anything changes. Finanse records transactions that already happened: it does not move money, connect to banks, or ask for card details.
payload.longDescription:
Finanse是一款适用于个人和家庭的共同预算应用。
一个连接涵盖你所有的预算项目——你可以询问当前的项目，或通过名称指定其他项目。
询问某个月份的钱花在哪里，分类如何分配，是否在预算范围内，余额如何变化，月底前可以安全支出多少，以及有哪些即将发生的固定付款——答案以清晰的卡片形式呈现，而不是大段文字。
你可以记录支出或收入，一次记录多个，或整张收据按类别划分，设置周期性付款并跟踪储蓄目标。
更改、删除和收据始终会显示预览，供你确认后再进行任何更改。
Finanse记录已经发生的交易——它不会转移资金，不会连接银行，也不会要求提供卡号信息。

一个连接涵盖你所有的预算项目——你可以询问当前的项目，或通过名称指定其他项目。

你可以记录支出或收入，一次记录多个，或整张收据按类别划分，设置周期性付款并跟踪储蓄目标。

payload.name: Ultralayer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Realtime market intelligence for AI agents: what changed, who is affected, and what to watch next. One suite covering news, events, guidance, filing changes, sentiment, stakeholders, and alerts. Information-efficient responses with evidence for every result. First-class point-in-time safety for backtests. Pairs well with web search and a market-data API. All data is our own.
payload.longDescription:
面向AI代理的实时市场情报：哪些变化发生、谁受到牵动、以及需要关注的后续动态。
一站式解决方案涵盖新闻、事件、指引、公告变更、市场情绪、利益相关方和预警信息。
每个结果均附有证据的信息高效响应。
为回测提供首屈一指的时间点安全性。
可与网络搜索和市场数据API完美搭配。
所有数据均为我们自有。

payload.name: Squidlor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask Codex for the price of BTC, ETH, NVDA or any Squidlor feed and get the aggregated on-chain median with the provider breakdown behind it: what Chainlink, Pyth, RedStone and the rest each reported, how stale each print is, and whether they agree. Pull history, OHLC candles and the audit trail of flagged deviations. Look up a wallet's balances across EVM chains and prepare a token transfer: Squidlor resolves the token from what the wallet holds, checks the balance, and returns an unsigned transaction. Nothing in this plugin can sign or move funds; the user signs with their own wallet.
payload.longDescription: 向Codex查询BTC、ETH、NVDA或任何Squidlor数据源的价格，并获取聚合后的链上中位数，以及各数据源的详细报告：Chainlink、Pyth、RedStone等各自提供的数据、各数据源的更新时效性，以及它们之间是否达成一致。获取历史数据、K线图以及标记异常的审计追踪记录。查询EVM链上钱包余额并准备代币转账：Squidlor会解析钱包持有的代币类型，检查余额，并返回未签名的交易。此插件无法签署或转移资金；用户需使用自己的钱包进行签名。

payload.name: RentBuy.org
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore a 30-year rent-versus-buy comparison in USD. Adjust purchase, mortgage, rental, investment and simplified US tax assumptions; inspect interactive charts and year-by-year results; compare scenarios and explore sensitivity. Open the calculator from the sidebar or beside your conversation. Results are educational estimates, not forecasts. No sign-in or financial account access is required.
payload.longDescription:
以美元进行30年的租金与购房对比分析。
调整购房、贷款、租金、投资及简化美国税制假设；查看交互式图表和逐年结果；对比不同情景并探索敏感性分析。
从侧边栏或对话旁边打开计算器。
结果为教育性估算，非预测。
无需登录或访问财务账户。

payload.name: Coinversa Pulse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Coinversa Pulse provides read-only analytics for Hyperliquid markets. Explore open interest, long/short positioning, liquidation risk, public-wallet trading activity, behavioral cohorts and builder revenue. Compare related assets across venues, inspect order-book structure, and check the coverage and freshness of available data. Coinversa supports market research and analytics; it does not place orders, sign transactions or transfer funds.
payload.longDescription: Coinversa Pulse为Hyperliquid市场提供只读分析功能。包括未平仓合约、多空头寸、清算风险、公共钱包交易活动、行为群体和开发者收入。跨市场比较相关资产，检查订单簿结构，并查看可用数据的覆盖范围和更新频率。Coinversa支持市场研究和分析；它不处理订单、签署交易或转移资金。

payload.name: Foliyo Stocks & MFs
payload.description: 印度股票、指数及共同基金
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Indian stocks, Sectoral Indices, Mutual Funds, GIFT City funds with NAVs, returns and details. Access Indian market data for end-of-day Stocks Quotes, ETFs, benchmark and sectoral indices, Mutual Funds and GIFT City funds. Provides instrument search, quotes, percentage returns across standard windows, historical price series, fund details on asset allocation, holdings, rolling returns, sharpe-ratio. Factual and educational market data only, not financial or investment advice.
payload.longDescription: 印度股票、行业指数、共同基金、GIFT城基金的净值、收益及详细信息。访问印度市场数据，包括收盘股票报价、ETF、基准指数和行业指数、共同基金及GIFT城基金。提供工具搜索、报价、标准时间窗口内的百分比收益、历史价格序列、资产配置、持仓、滚动收益、夏普比率等基金详情。仅提供事实性和教育性市场数据，不构成金融或投资建议。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search Indian stocks and indices, Check stock and NAV quotes, Analyze historical returns

payload.name: Finrep
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring Finrep's SEC reporting and technical accounting research into ChatGPT. Search EDGAR filings, accounting standards, and SEC comment letters, benchmark disclosure language against peers, and draft disclosures. Every answer cites the source it came from, so reporting teams can verify it before it goes into a filing.
payload.longDescription: 将Finrep的SEC报告和技术会计研究整合到ChatGPT中。搜索EDGAR文件、会计准则和SEC评论信，将披露语言与同行进行基准对比，并起草披露内容。每个答案都会标注来源，使报告团队在文件提交前能够进行验证。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Research accounting standards with citations, Find what the SEC has pushed back on in comment letters, Benchmark disclosure language against peer filings, Draft disclosure language grounded in real filings, Continue an earlier Finrep chat, Open your saved Finrep drafts, documents and citations

payload.name: OfficeHubb
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OfficeHubb connects you with independent insurance agencies in the United States that use OfficeHubb to run their office.

Name an agency or a town and OfficeHubb finds it, with its phone, the lines of insurance it writes and the towns it serves. Ask for a quote and OfficeHubb gets that agency's own questions, you answer them, and after you agree to share your details, the request goes straight to the agency. A licensed agent there prepares the quote and reaches out by phone or email, usually within the agency's stated time. Existing clients can also ask their agency for help with a policy, such as ID cards, billing or a change.

What it does not do: it does not sell insurance, give prices on its own, bind coverage or recommend one agency or carrier over another. A quote is not coverage; nothing is covered until a licensed agent takes an application and the policy is bound. Medicare and health plan requests go to the agency directly. OfficeHubb never asks for a Social Security, driver license, Medicare, card or bank number, and an assistant can never sign you up for text messages.

Available for agencies that use OfficeHubb, in the United States.
payload.longDescription:
OfficeHubb将您与美国使用OfficeHubb运营办公室的独立保险代理机构相连接。

输入代理机构名称或城镇，OfficeHubb会找到对应的机构信息，包括电话、承保范围及服务的城镇。
请求报价时，OfficeHubb会获取该代理机构的专属问题，您只需回答这些问题，同意分享个人信息后，申请将直接发送给该机构。
持牌代理会准备报价，并通过电话或电子邮件联系您，通常在机构声明的时间内完成。
现有客户也可向代理机构寻求保单帮助，例如身份卡、账单或保单变更事宜。

它不从事以下操作：不销售保险、不自行提供价格、不承保或推荐特定代理机构或保险公司。
报价不等于承保；在持牌代理接收申请并正式承保前，任何内容均不生效。
医疗保险和健康计划请求将直接发送给代理机构。
OfficeHubb不会要求提供社会安全号、驾驶执照、医疗保险卡或银行账户信息，助理人员也无法为您订阅短信服务。

仅限美国地区使用OfficeHubb的代理机构可用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find an insurance agency, Request an insurance quote, Request help with a policy, Check on a request

payload.name: Trader.AI
payload.description: 探索经过回测的交易策略
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse the Trader.AI leaderboard of published, AI-built trading strategies and inspect how each one performed in deterministic historical backtests: total return, maximum drawdown, win rate, Sharpe ratio, profit factor, backtest settings and an equity curve summary. Filter by market (for example EURUSD or XAUUSD) or asset class, sort by return, drawdown, trade count or backtest length, and look up a creator's published strategies. Every result links to the strategy page on trader.ai. All figures are historical backtest results, not live trading results or investment advice. Trader.AI does not place trades. Connecting requires signing in with a Trader.AI account.
payload.longDescription: 浏览Trader.AI发布的AI构建交易策略排行榜，并查看每个策略在确定性的历史回测中的表现详情：总收益、最大回撤、胜率、夏普比率、盈亏比、回测设置以及权益曲线概览。通过市场（例如EURUSD或XAUUSD）或资产类别进行筛选，按收益、回撤、交易次数或回测时长排序，并查找创作者发布的策略。每个结果都会链接到trader.ai上的策略页面。所有数据均为历史回测结果，非实时交易结果或投资建议。Trader.AI不会执行交易。连接需使用Trader.AI账户登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Browse strategy leaderboard, View strategy backtest results, View creator profiles

payload.name: FocusPulse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FocusPulse returns recent news stories for India and the United States that are linked to a specific listed company, commodity, index or the rupee. For each story it gives the headline, a short summary, one sentence on what the story reports about the linked instruments, and up to three publications that reported it, with links.

Ask for the top stories in a country, or search by a company, commodity or topic. Stories cover the last 48 hours. Only stories that pass our relevance check are returned, so a quiet day returns few results.

Information only. FocusPulse does not give investment advice, price targets or buy/sell calls. Summaries are generated by software from published articles and may contain errors; the source links lead to the original reporting. No account is needed. Requests are limited to 60 a minute.
payload.longDescription:
FocusPulse会返回与特定上市公司、商品、指数或卢比相关的印度和美国近期新闻故事。每篇新闻会显示标题、简要摘要、关于所关联工具的简短说明，以及最多三家媒体报道的来源链接。

可要求获取某国的头条新闻，或按公司、商品或主题进行搜索。新闻内容涵盖最近48小时的信息。只有通过相关性检查的新闻才会被返回，因此在交易清淡时段可能仅显示少量结果。

仅提供信息。FocusPulse不提供投资建议、价格目标或买卖建议。摘要由软件从已发表文章中生成，可能包含错误；来源链接会指向原始报道。无需账户即可使用。每分钟请求次数限制为60次。

payload.name: GrantLedger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GrantLedger is the open ledger of public funding: grants, loans, guarantees and tax credits published by official bodies in 21 European countries and EU-wide programmes, collected every night from official sources and searchable in any language. Ask which calls fund an industrial SME in Spain, what a loan guarantee in Germany requires, or which EU programmes fit a deep-tech startup; every answer links the official publisher page. Pro accounts can paste the link of their GrantLedger screening result: the assistant reads the company profile they confirmed and every call screened for it with the rule each verdict relies on, then ranks, explains gaps and compares calls. Verdicts come from fixed rules on grantledger.eu, never from the model. Sign in with your GrantLedger Pro account when ChatGPT asks. Read only: the plugin cannot change your profiles or your account.
payload.longDescription: GrantLedger是欧洲公共资金的公开账本：包含21个欧洲国家及欧盟范围计划的拨款、贷款、担保和税收抵免信息，每日从官方渠道收集并支持多语言搜索。可查询西班牙工业中小企业的资助计划、德国贷款担保要求或适合深科技初创企业的欧盟计划；每个答案均链接至官方发布页面。Pro账户可粘贴GrantLedger筛选结果链接，助手将读取已确认的企业资料及针对该企业的所有筛选结果，并根据每项结论依赖的规则进行排序、解释差异并比较资助计划。结论来源于grantledger.eu的固定规则，而非模型生成。当ChatGPT提示时，请使用GrantLedger Pro账户登录。仅限只读：插件无法修改您的资料或账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search public funding calls across Europe by text, country, status and type, Read the full record of a call with the official publisher link, Read a GrantLedger screening result from its link and explain each verdict, Rank, compare and explain calls for a company profile

payload.name: WalletGraph: Address Lookup
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WalletGraph connects public entities, accounts, and onchain addresses when an authoritative source supports the relationship. Look up an exact address or account to see its relationship type, review date, and evidence URL. Coverage is limited to a small reviewed index of published protocol and token contracts. Empty results mean no reviewed mapping is in this index. WalletGraph does not infer personal wallet ownership, request API keys, access GMGN accounts, or execute trades.
payload.longDescription: 当存在权威来源支持该关联关系时，WalletGraph会将公共实体、账户和链上地址进行关联。查询特定地址或账户，以查看其关联类型、审核日期和证据链接。覆盖范围仅限于已审核的已发布协议和代币合约的小型索引。无结果表示该索引中未收录任何已审核的映射。WalletGraph不会推断个人钱包所有权、请求API密钥、访问GMGN账户或执行交易。

payload.name: UAE Gratuity Calculator
payload.description: 阿联酋服务结束津贴计算器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Enter your start date, last working day and monthly basic salary. The calculator applies the 21-day and 30-day rates, the one-year minimum, unpaid leave, part-time hours and the cap under Federal Decree-Law 33 of 2021. DIFC employees see the gratuity owed for service before February 2020 and their DEWS contribution rate. ADGM employees get the 2024 rules with no cap. Every answer shows the law it used and the assumptions where the law is silent. General information only, not personalised advice.
payload.longDescription:
输入您的入职日期、最后工作日和月基本工资。
计算工具会应用21天和30天的费率、一年最低服务期、无薪假期、兼职工时以及2021年第33号联邦法令规定的封顶金额。
DIFC员工可查看2020年2月前服务期的津贴金额及DEWS缴费比例。
ADGM员工适用2024年规则且无封顶金额。
每个计算结果都会显示所依据的法律条款以及法律未明确规定时的假设条件。
仅提供一般性信息，不构成个性化建议。

payload.name: Seaworthy Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Seaworthy Insurance estimates what individual disability insurance would cost you, based on your occupation, age, sex, and income. The prices come from more than 400 carrier illustrations Seaworthy ran in 2026 across five disability insurers. They are built from Texas illustrations, so your state can change the final premium, ages 46 to 55 are projected from the illustrated ages, and some ranges include a professional or training discount. No carrier is named.

The card opens on the benefit and plan design Seaworthy's advisors usually start with for someone in your position. From there you can change the monthly benefit, the waiting period, inflation protection, and catastrophic coverage, and the estimate updates as you go. Every estimate is priced with a true own-occupation definition, partial disability coverage, and benefits to age 65, and the advisor confirms what your occupation class can get.

When you want real quotes, the card sends your request to a licensed Seaworthy advisor, who follows up within one business day. Requesting quotes is free and asks no health questions. These are estimates, not quotes, and underwriting and health history set the final premium.

Seaworthy Insurance is an independent disability insurance brokerage for physicians, dentists, CRNAs, attorneys, tech professionals, and other high earners, licensed in all 50 states.
payload.longDescription:
Seaworthy Insurance会根据您的职业、年龄、性别和收入估算个人残疾保险的费用。价格数据来自Seaworthy在2026年针对五家残疾保险公司运行的400多份承保人图示。这些数据基于得克萨斯州的图示生成，因此您的所在州可能会影响最终保费，46至55岁人群的保费是根据图示年龄预测的，部分费率范围包含专业或培训折扣。未提及任何具体承保人。

该卡片会从Seaworthy顾问通常为您的情况设计的保障方案和计划配置开始。您可以在此基础上调整月度保障金额、等待期、通胀保护和重大疾病保障，调整过程中估算金额会实时更新。每次估算均采用真正的职业定义、部分残疾保障，并覆盖至65岁年龄，顾问会确认您的职业类别可获得的保障范围。

当您需要真实报价时，该卡片会将请求发送给持牌的Seaworthy顾问，顾问将在一个工作日内跟进。请求报价完全免费且无需回答健康问题。以上均为估算数据，最终保费需通过核保和健康记录确定。

Seaworthy Insurance是面向医生、牙医、麻醉护士执业者（CRNAs）、律师、科技专业人员及其他高收入人群的独立残疾保险经纪公司，已在全美50个州取得执业许可。

payload.name: Jelli
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jelli is a budgeting app where your money is sorted into virtual jars. Connect it and ChatGPT can see your jars, transactions, spending trends and recurring charges, check whether your banks are syncing, and draft changes for you: sorting unassigned transactions into jars using Jelli's own suggestions, moving money between jars, creating or editing jars, and splitting a paycheck. Every change is previewed first and only applied when you say so. Jelli never moves real money, and nothing here can.
payload.longDescription: Jelli是一款预算应用，会将您的资金分入虚拟钱罐中。连接Jelli后，ChatGPT可以查看您的钱罐、交易记录、消费趋势和定期费用，检查您的银行账户是否同步，并为您草拟更改方案：根据Jelli的建议将未分类交易归入对应钱罐、在钱罐间调拨资金、创建或编辑钱罐，以及拆分工资。所有更改都会先预览，仅在您确认后才会执行。Jelli永远不会动用真实资金，此处的任何操作都不会导致实际资金变动。

payload.name: Pappers France
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pappers gives ChatGPT access to French legal and public data from more than a hundred official sources, updated daily.

- Companies: search companies by name or criteria and read their profiles (SIREN, directors, beneficial owners, filings, annual accounts, ownership maps).
- Compliance: screen individuals against politically exposed person (PEP) and international sanctions lists.
- Legal: explore French case law and legislation, and get sourced legal research notes.
- Real estate: query land-registry and property data (parcels, owners, sales, buildings, energy-performance certificates).
- Politics: follow French and EU parliamentary activity (members of parliament, votes, amendments, bills) and local-government documents.

Designed for financial analysis, sales screening, investment and M&A, compliance and due diligence (KYC, KYB, AML), legal research, real estate, local-government monitoring, and public affairs, all from a single connector.

Limitations: coverage is limited to French entities and French and EU public records. A Pappers account is required, and beneficial-owner data requires a legitimate-interest authorization. The plugin only reads data: it cannot file formalities, change registry records, or access private information such as bank accounts. Results are informational and are not legal, financial, or credit advice.
payload.longDescription:
Pappers为ChatGPT提供法国官方数据源的访问权限，涵盖来自100多个权威渠道的法律及公共数据，每日更新。

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Edgio Signals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mit Edgio Signals kannst du in ChatGPT den aktuellen Stand der Edgio-Signale für Aktien, ETFs und Sektoren abrufen. Edgio ist ein signalbasiertes Analyse-Tool für Aktien- und ETF-Anleger. Das Plugin gibt die öffentlich zugänglichen Signale im Chat wieder.

Das kannst du damit tun:
- Einen Wert einordnen: der aktuelle Edgio Score von 0 bis 100, die Signale dahinter (Trend, Momentum, Oszillatoren, relative Stärke), Risikokennzahlen und die Position im Sektor.
- Zwei oder drei Werte vergleichen: Score, Performance, Volatilität und Drawdown nebeneinander.
- Einen Sektor einordnen: die Verteilung der Scores und der Durchschnitt im Vergleich zum Gesamtuniversum.
- Den Markt-Pulse abrufen: ein Überblick über das kuratierte Universum mit den Sektoren mit dem höchsten und dem niedrigsten durchschnittlichen Score.

Jede Antwort nennt den Datenstand, die Quelle mit Link und eine Offenlegung möglicher Interessenkonflikte des Gründers. Es ist keine Anmeldung nötig.

Gut zu wissen: Das Plugin deckt nur das kuratierte Edgio-Universum ab und liefert keine Echtzeitkurse. Es führt keine Orders aus, greift nicht auf dein Depot zu und zeigt weder Kursziele noch vollständige Ranglisten. Die Ergebnisse beschreiben den Zustand zum genannten Datum. Sie sind beschreibende Marktinformationen, keine persönliche Anlageberatung und keine Empfehlung.
payload.longDescription:
通过Edgio Signals，你可以在ChatGPT中查询股票、ETF及行业板块的实时Edgio信号。
Edgio是面向股票和ETF投资者的基于信号的分析工具。
该插件会展示Chat中可公开获取的信号数据。

你可以通过以下方式使用：
- 对单一资产进行分析：显示当前Edgio评分（0-100分）、背后的信号类型（趋势、动量、震荡指标、相对强度）、风险指标以及行业位置。
- 对比两到三个资产：并列展示评分、表现、波动率和回撤数据。
- 对行业板块进行分析：显示该板块评分分布情况及与整体市场的平均分对比。
- 获取市场脉搏：查看精选资产池的概览，包含平均分最高和最低的行业板块。

每次回复都会标注数据更新时间、来源链接，并声明创始人可能存在的利益冲突。
使用无需注册。

需要注意：该插件仅覆盖经过筛选的Edgio数据库，不提供实时行情。
不执行交易操作，不访问你的投资组合，不展示价格目标或完整排名。
所有结果仅反映标注日期的市场状态。
这些信息仅作市场描述用途，不构成投资建议或推荐。

payload.name: Prop Trading Intelligence
payload.description: 自营交易公司规则，附来源
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Prop Trading Intelligence answers questions about prop trading firms' evaluation rules from a hand-checked dataset. Every rule value comes with a quote from the firm's own website, a link to that page and the date it was verified there.

Use it to:
- see which firms and programmes are covered
- find programmes that meet conditions such as news trading allowed, weekend holding, no consistency rule, a drawdown type, a minimum profit split, no time limit or a fee refund
- look up a programme's evaluation fees by account size, in the currency the firm lists
- read one firm's rules: profit targets, daily and maximum drawdown, time limits, minimum trading days, consistency, payouts and more
- get plain definitions of prop trading rules
- calculate a position size from account size, risk and stop loss, or the gain needed to recover from a drawdown

It is for traders researching prop firm evaluations and anyone learning how prop firm rules work. No sign-in is needed.

Limitations: the dataset covers forex and CFD programmes, and firms are added over time. A rule that has not been verified is reported as not yet verified, which means unknown, not absent. Firms can change their rules between checks, so every value shows its verified date and is flagged once a re-check is due. Fees are never converted between currencies. Results are listed alphabetically and are not a ranking or a recommendation. The plugin does not give trading advice, place trades, access trading accounts or sell anything.

The data is Pipster Research (CC BY 4.0), published by Data Vantix Ltd, which trades as Pipster, a prop firm. Pipster's own programmes are included and are checked by the same method as every other firm's.
payload.longDescription:
Prop Trading Intelligence 通过人工核查的数据集，解答关于自营交易公司评估规则的问题。每个规则值都附有该机构官网的引用、该页面链接以及验证日期。

可用于：
- 查看哪些机构和项目被覆盖
- 查找符合特定条件的项目，如允许新闻交易、周末持仓、无一致性规则、特定回撤类型、最低利润分成、无时间限制或费用退款
- 按账户规模查询项目的评估费用，以机构列出的货币计价
- 阅读某家机构的规则：盈利目标、每日及最大回撤、时间限制、最低交易天数、一致性要求、收益分配等
- 获取自营交易规则的明确定义
- 根据账户规模、风险和止损计算仓位大小，或计算回撤后所需盈利金额

适用于研究自营交易公司评估的交易者以及了解自营交易规则运作机制的人士。
无需登录即可使用。

限制条件：数据集涵盖外汇和差价合约项目，机构会随时间逐步增加。
未验证的规则会标注为「尚未验证」，表示信息未知而非规则缺失。
机构可能在核查间隔期内修改规则，因此每个数据项均显示验证日期，并在重新核查到期时标记提醒。
费用不会在不同货币间转换。
结果按字母顺序排列，不代表排名或推荐。
该插件不提供交易建议、不执行交易、不访问交易账户且不销售任何产品。

数据来源为 Pipster Research（CC BY 4.0），由 Data Vantix Ltd 发布，该公司以 Pipster 名义运营，是一家自营交易公司。
Pipster 自身的项目也包含在内，并采用与其他机构相同的核查方法。

payload.name: Floyd by The F Suite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The F Suite is a members-only community of CFOs and their finance teams. Floyd brings the community's collective experience and knowledge into ChatGPT and Codex, so finance leaders can see what peers at comparable companies and in similar situations actually did before making a decision.

Floyd has two read-only tools:

get_peer_insights answers questions of practice and judgment: how CFOs structure a board package, what a normal burn multiple looks like at Series B, how teams handled a covenant breach or a restatement. It draws on 2,800+ discussion threads across eight CFO peer networks, shared models and templates, and F Suite event recordings.

find_vendors names specific software vendors; audit, accounting, and tax firms; service providers; and individual practitioners. Its recommendations come from 6,000+ peer mentions rather than analyst grids or vendor marketing.

Every response includes inline citations linking back to the original F Suite discussion threads, documents, events, and recordings, so answers can be checked at the source.

Floyd is called only when it is relevant to the question at hand; nothing is pushed into the conversation. Access requires an active F Suite membership. Every member connects to the same server URL and signs in with their F Suite account over OAuth 2.0, and each member's answers are scoped to the peer networks they belong to.
payload.longDescription:
The F Suite是面向CFO及其财务团队的会员制社区。Floyd将社区的集体经验和知识引入ChatGPT和Codex，使财务领导者在做决策前能查看同等规模公司和类似情况下的同行实际采取了哪些措施。

Floyd提供两个只读工具：

get_peer_insights用于解答实践与判断类问题：CFO如何构建董事会资料包？B轮融资阶段的正常烧钱倍数是什么样？团队如何处理契约违约或财务重述问题？该功能基于八个CFO同行网络中的2800+讨论帖、共享的模型模板以及F Suite活动记录。

find_vendors可查询具体的软件供应商、审计会计税务事务所、服务商及个人从业者。其推荐结果来自6000+同行提及记录，而非分析师榜单或供应商营销内容。

每个回答均包含内联引用，可链接回原始的F Suite讨论帖、文档、活动和录音，方便从源头核对信息。

只有在问题相关时才会调用Floyd，不会主动向对话中推送内容。访问需有效F Suite会员资格。每位成员通过OAuth 2.0协议使用F Suite账户登录同一服务器地址，且每位成员的回答内容仅限其所属的同行网络范围。

payload.name: Creddy: Credit Card Rewards
payload.description: 信用卡权益、信用额度和积分
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Creddy helps you get more from the credit cards you have and choose the next one with care.

Ask which of your cards to use at a store or for a category, and Creddy ranks your cards by effective return: each card's earn rate multiplied by Creddy's estimate of what its points are worth. Ask what a card includes and Creddy shows its annual fee, earn rates, statement credits with when each one resets, lounge access, elite status, insurance and purchase protections, foreign transaction fee, and current welcome offer. Compare two or three cards side by side, get a short list of cards to consider for a spend category, no annual fee, or lounge access, and see where a points currency transfers, at what ratio, and which transfer bonuses are running now.

Card data comes from Creddy's reviewed catalog of US credit cards, built from each issuer's published terms and kept current by the Creddy team. Card names can be written the way people say them, such as "Amex Gold" or "CSR".

Limitations: Creddy covers US consumer and business credit cards only. It does not need an account, never asks for card numbers or login details, and cannot apply for cards, move points, or make purchases. Point values are estimates, and offers and terms can change, so confirm the details with the issuer before you apply. Some answers include links to issuer application pages, and Creddy may earn a commission if you apply.
payload.longDescription:
Creddy帮助您充分利用现有信用卡并谨慎选择下一张信用卡。

询问在商店或某个消费类别中使用哪张信用卡时，Creddy会根据实际回报率对信用卡进行排序：每张信用卡的积分返现率乘以Creddy对积分价值的估算。
询问某张信用卡的权益内容时，Creddy会显示年费、积分返现率、账单抵扣及其重置时间、休息室访问权限、高级会员资格、保险和购物保护、外币交易费以及当前的开卡礼遇。
将两张或三张信用卡并排对比，获取针对特定消费类别、无年费或休息室权限的候选卡清单，并查看积分货币的兑换比例、当前可兑换的积分奖励及兑换优惠。

信用卡数据来自Creddy经过审核的美国信用卡目录，该目录基于发卡机构公开条款建立，并由Creddy团队持续更新。
信用卡名称可使用人们常用的写法，例如「Amex Gold」或「CSR」。

限制条件：Creddy仅支持美国消费者和商务信用卡。
无需账户即可使用，不会要求输入卡号或登录信息，也无法申请信用卡、转移积分或进行购物。
积分价值为估算值，且优惠条款可能变动，请在申请前与发卡机构确认详细信息。
部分回答包含发卡机构申请页面链接，若通过这些链接申请，Creddy可能获得佣金。

information.label: Capabilities

payload.name: Trackstone
payload.description: 出租房产：价格与回报率
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find out what your rented property is worth, or find one that already pays rent, without leaving the conversation.

Trackstone is a French real estate agency dedicated to rented properties: the property is sold with its tenant in place, and the lease simply continues with the new owner. The seller does not wait for the tenant to leave, and the buyer collects rent from day one.

What you can do:
- Value your rented apartment or house. Get a price range, the price per square meter and the gross yield your property offers a buyer, calculated from real comparable sales in your area (French public land registry, DVF), with a reliability score from 1 to 5.
- Browse rented properties for sale. Tell ChatGPT your city, your budget and the gross or net yield you are aiming for: Trackstone shows matching listings with photos, price, rent and both yields, sorted by the yield that matters to you.
- Read a city's market at a glance: price per square meter for apartments and houses, how prices have moved year after year, median rent and gross yield.

From any result, one click takes you to Trackstone to open the detailed estimate, view the listing or talk to an advisor about your sale.

Made for owners who want to sell a rented property in France, and for investors who want a property that earns rent from the first month.

Good to know: France only. Estimates cover apartments and houses; they are indicative, not formal appraisals, and less precise where few sales exist. Search results only include properties published publicly on Trackstone. No account is required, and the plugin never makes offers or transactions on your behalf.
payload.longDescription:
无需离开对话界面，即可了解您的出租房产价值，或寻找已产生租金收益的房产。

Trackstone是一家法国房地产中介，专注出租房产交易：房产连同租客一并出售，租赁合同由新业主继续履行。卖方无需等待租客搬离，买方从成交第一天起即可收取租金。

您可以：
- 评估出租公寓或住宅价值
获取价格区间、每平方米价格及买家可获得的毛回报率，该数据基于您所在区域的真实成交案例（法国公共土地登记处DVF数据），并附带1到5分的可靠性评分。
- 浏览待售出租房产
告诉ChatGPT您的城市、预算以及目标毛回报率或净回报率：Trackstone将展示匹配房源，包含照片、价格、租金及两种回报率，按您关注的回报率排序。
- 快速了解城市市场情况：公寓和住宅的每平方米价格、历年价格变化趋势、中位租金及毛回报率。

在任何搜索结果页面，一键跳转至Trackstone查看详细估价、房源信息或联系顾问咨询出售事宜。

专为希望出售法国出租房产的业主，以及希望获得首月即可产生租金收益房产的投资者设计。

重要说明：仅适用于法国。
估价范围包括公寓和住宅；估价结果仅供参考，非正式评估报告，在成交案例较少的区域可能精度较低。
搜索结果仅包含Trackstone平台公开发布的房源。
无需账户即可使用，插件不会以您的名义进行任何报价或交易。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Estimate a rented property, Search rented properties for sale, Check city real estate prices

payload.name: Keel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keel turns your ideas into systematic strategies for Hyperliquid crypto perpetual futures (perps). Connect it to ChatGPT, describe a strategy, and ChatGPT builds it from Keel's strategy components, backtests it on real Hyperliquid history with fees and slippage, and explains the results.

With Keel in ChatGPT you can:
- Build and edit strategies by describing them
- Backtest them and compare runs side by side
- Start from a verified strategy in the Keel library
- Keep notes on strategies and share a result by link
- See how the strategies you run in Keel are doing

Everything you create stays in your Keel workspace. Nothing is public unless you share it.

Keel in ChatGPT is for strategy research and backtesting. It does not place trades, submit orders, move funds or connect wallets — no order executes inside ChatGPT. What it writes is limited to your own Keel workspace: strategy drafts, backtest runs, notes and share links. Running a strategy with real capital is set up and approved by you in the Keel web app, outside ChatGPT. Backtests are simulations on historical data, not predictions or financial advice; trading perpetual futures carries a substantial risk of loss.

Keel measures the strategies you design. It does not give investment advice or recommendations, and backtest results do not predict future returns.
payload.longDescription:
Keel 将您的想法转化为适用于 Hyperliquid 加密货币永续期货（perps）的系统化策略。连接至 ChatGPT，描述策略，ChatGPT 将基于 Keel 的策略组件构建策略，使用手续费和滑点在真实 Hyperliquid 历史数据上进行回测，并解释结果。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Keel 可实现：
- 通过描述构建和编辑策略
- 进行回测并并排比较不同运行结果
- 从 Keel 库中已验证的策略开始
- 为策略添加备注并通过链接分享结果
- 查看您在 Keel 中运行的策略表现

您创建的所有内容都会保存在个人 Keel 工作区中。
除非您主动分享，否则内容不会公开。

ChatGPT 中的 Keel 仅用于策略研究和回测。
它不会执行交易、提交订单、转移资金或连接钱包——ChatGPT 内部不会执行任何订单。
其生成内容仅限于您的个人 Keel 工作区：策略草案、回测记录、备注和分享链接。
使用真实资金运行策略需在 Keel 网页应用中独立完成，且需您自行设置并确认。
回测基于历史数据模拟，非未来预测或金融建议；交易永续期货存在重大亏损风险。

Keel 会评估您设计的策略。
但不会提供投资建议或推荐，回测结果不预示未来收益。

payload.name: MortgageCompare
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare two to four U.S. fixed-rate mortgage offers for the same loan amount using confirmed Loan Estimate figures. See payments, discount points, closing fees, lender credits, prepaid interest and mortgage insurance alongside financing cost over the time you expect to keep the loan. Change the holding period, inspect cost crossovers, principal repaid and remaining balances, and export your comparison. ChatGPT can help read Loan Estimates attached to your conversation; MortgageCompare receives structured financial figures, not the original documents. No live rate shopping, lender referrals, applications or approval decisions. The model supports fully amortizing loans, cash-paid fees and an explicit constant mortgage-insurance amount/duration. Confirm figures with your lenders.
payload.longDescription:
使用确认的贷款估算数据，比较2至4份相同贷款金额的美国固定利率抵押贷款报价。
显示还款金额、折扣点、结案费用、贷款人信用额度、预付利息和抵押贷款保险费用，以及您预计持有贷款期间的融资成本。
调整持有期限，查看成本交叉点、已还本金和剩余余额，并导出您的比较结果。
ChatGPT可帮助解读您对话中附加的贷款估算文件；MortgageCompare接收结构化财务数据，而非原始文件。
不提供实时利率比价、贷款机构推荐、申请或审批决策。
该模型支持全额摊销贷款、现金支付费用以及明确的固定抵押贷款保险金额/期限。
请与贷款机构确认数据准确性。

payload.name: Redbark
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Redbark connects your bank and brokerage accounts in Australia, New Zealand and the United States, and syncs them to Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, YNAB or a webhook.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can read the accounts you have connected to Redbark:
- Balances across all your accounts
- Transactions, with search by date, amount and description
- Spending summaries by category and merchant
- Brokerage holdings and trades
- The status of your syncs, with a diagnosis when one fails

It can also start a sync run on request, and give you a link to connect a new bank.

The plugin is read-only for your bank accounts. It cannot move money, make payments or place trades. It only sees accounts you have connected to your own Redbark account.

Requires a Redbark account.
payload.longDescription:
Redbark可连接澳大利亚、新西兰和美国的银行账户及经纪账户，并将数据同步至Google Sheets、Airtable、Notion、YNAB或网络钩子

通过此插件，ChatGPT可读取你已连接至Redbark的账户信息：
- 所有账户的余额情况
- 交易记录（支持按日期、金额、描述搜索）
- 按类别和商户统计的支出摘要
- 证券持仓及交易记录
- 同步状态显示，异常时提供诊断信息

插件支持按需启动数据同步，并提供连接新银行账户的指引链接

该插件仅对银行账户保持只读模式
无法执行资金转账、支付操作或下单交易
仅能访问你本人Redbark账户所连接的银行账户

需要拥有Redbark账户

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use your saved Finnce records to understand your portfolio and organize your investment research. With your permission, read saved portfolios, positions, purchases and sales; review watchlists and existing alerts; add an asset to a selected watchlist; and create or review thesis, contingency, review and checklist drafts. You choose the permitted data and actions in Finnce and can pause or revoke access there. Saved records may be incomplete and are not independently verified broker history. Drafts require your review. Finnce does not trade, move money, alter your purchases or sales, or guarantee returns. Creating new price alerts through this connection is currently unavailable. A Finnce account and a completed connection are required; installing the plugin alone does not authorize access.

使用您保存的Finnce记录来了解您的投资组合并整理投资研究资料。
在获得您的授权后，可读取保存的投资组合、持仓、买入和卖出记录；查看关注列表和现有警报；将资产添加到选定的关注列表中；创建或查看投资逻辑、应急方案、复盘和检查清单草案。
您可以在Finnce中选择允许的数据和操作，并可随时暂停或撤销访问权限。
保存的记录可能不完整，且并非独立验证的经纪商历史记录。
草案需要您进行审核。
Finnce不进行交易、资金划转、修改您的买入或卖出操作，也不保证收益。
通过此连接创建新价格警报的功能目前暂不可用。
需要Finnce账户和完成连接；单独安装插件不会授予访问权限。

payload.name: Daffy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Daffy is a donor-advised fund: one account for all your giving. Add cash, stock, or crypto, get your tax deduction when you contribute, invest it to grow tax-free, and give to any of 1.5 million+ US charities whenever you're ready.

With Daffy in ChatGPT, your giving is one question away:

• Know where you stand. Ask for your balance, how much you can give right now, how your fund is invested, and how it has performed.
• See your giving history. Pull up donations by year or charity, review your contributions, and export a fund statement as CSV for tax time.
• Give in the moment. Say "give $100 to the local food bank" and Daffy recommends the donation from your fund to that charity. ChatGPT confirms the charity and amount before anything happens, and you can cancel a donation until it's paid out.
• Find the right charity. Search 1.5M+ US nonprofits by name or cause, or look one up by EIN, and get its mission, location, website, and Daffy profile.

Everything runs through your existing Daffy account with your normal login. Read-only questions never change anything, and no donation is ever made without your explicit approval.

You'll need a Daffy account (daffy.org). Available to Daffy members in the US.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search charities, Read fund activity, Export statements, Make donations, Cancel eligible donations

payload.name: Wealth Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wealth Tracker keeps your whole net worth in one place: cash and savings, investments, crypto, property, vehicles and other valuables, minus mortgages, loans and other debts. Connect it to ChatGPT to ask about your money in plain words and keep your records up to date from the conversation.

What you can do:
- See your net worth, totals, allocation and liquidity, how they have moved over time, and the income your holdings earned.
- Find any holding by name, ticker or ISIN, and list everything that is due or out of date for an update.
- Record a balance, a buy or sell you have already made, interest or a fee, or a whole account statement or screenshot at once. Every change can be previewed first, returns a receipt, and can be undone within 30 days.
- Choose how often Wealth Tracker reminds you to update an account or a holding.
- If you have connected a bank in the Wealth Tracker app: see spending and income by category, merchant and period, search your transactions, review subscriptions and other recurring payments, recategorise transactions, and mark a recurring payment as confirmed, dismissed or cancelled in your records.

What it does not do:
- It never moves money, makes payments or places trades. Buys and sells are records of trades you made elsewhere.
- Bank data is read-only. It cannot connect a bank, sign in to your bank or broker, or change anything at your bank or at a merchant. Bank connections are set up in the Wealth Tracker app.
- It reads and changes only the signed-in user's own Wealth Tracker records, and sees nothing you have not added to Wealth Tracker.
- It reports your own figures and does not give investment, tax or financial advice.

You need a Wealth Tracker account and sign in with it when you connect.
payload.longDescription:
Wealth Tracker将您的全部净资产集中管理：包括现金和储蓄、投资、加密货币、房产、车辆及其他贵重物品，扣除抵押贷款、贷款及其他债务。
连接到ChatGPT即可用通俗语言询问您的财务状况，并通过对话保持记录更新。

您可以：
- 查看净资产、总金额、资产配置和流动性，以及它们随时间的变化情况，还有持仓产生的收入。
- 通过名称、代码或ISIN编号查找任何持仓，并列出所有需要更新的到期或过期项目。
- 一次性记录余额、已发生的买卖交易、利息或费用，或整份账户报表或截图。
每次更改均可先预览，生成收据，并可在30天内撤销。
- 自定义Wealth Tracker提醒您更新账户或持仓的频率。
- 如果已在Wealth Tracker应用中连接银行：可按类别、商家和周期查看收支情况，搜索交易记录，审查订阅及其他定期付款，重新分类交易，并在记录中将定期付款标记为已确认、已忽略或已取消。

它无法实现以下功能：
- 永不移动资金、发起付款或下单交易。
买卖操作仅记录您在其他平台完成的交易。
- 银行数据为只读模式。
无法连接银行、登录您的银行或券商，或在银行或商家端进行任何修改。
银行连接需在Wealth Tracker应用中设置。
- 仅读取和修改已登录用户自身的Wealth Tracker记录，不会查看您未添加到Wealth Tracker的信息。
- 仅报告您输入的数据，不提供投资、税务或财务建议。

您需要拥有Wealth Tracker账户，并在连接时使用该账户登录。

Create and update running, cycling and trail-running training plans and workouts, save reusable workout templates, and arrange workouts on your training schedule. payload.description: 基于 Garmin 数据的 AI 教练

Track daily wellness metrics including steps, heart rate, sleep quality, stress, and HRV. Analyze workouts with pace breakdown, lap splits, heart rate drift, and opt-in time-series data. Track weight, body composition, and menstrual cycle data. Monitor long-term fitness trends with up to 5 years of history. All data displays include Garmin attribution.

payload.name: Tredict
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tredict is a platform for endurance training planning, structured workouts, and workout analysis for athletes and coaches.

Create reusable training plans and structured workouts for running, cycling, swimming, and other sports directly in Tredict with ChatGPT. Plans can be tailored to your recent activities and preferred training approach, whether based on power, pace, or other performance metrics.

Execute your training plan directly on your sports watch through Tredict’s integrations with Garmin, Suunto, Polar, Wahoo, Coros, and other platforms.

Organize your training calendar with AI-powered assistance that helps summarize workouts and suggest meaningful titles and descriptions for your training sessions.

Analyze past training activities and generate structured workout plans that support long-term endurance training.

Tredict integrates with ChatGPT to help athletes and coaches organize and plan endurance training more efficiently.

Tredict is GDPR compliant.
payload.longDescription:
Tredict 是面向运动员和教练的耐力训练规划、结构化训练和训练分析平台。

通过 ChatGPT，你可以直接在 Tredict 中创建可重复使用的训练计划和结构化训练课程，适用于跑步、骑行、游泳及其他运动。计划可根据你近期的活动和偏好的训练方法进行定制，例如依据功率、配速或其他表现指标。

通过 Tredict 与 Garmin、Suunto、Polar、Wahoo、Coros 等平台的集成，可直接在运动手表上执行训练计划。

借助 AI 助手整理训练日历，汇总训练内容，并为训练课程建议恰当的标题和说明。

分析过往训练活动，并生成支持长期耐力训练的结构化训练计划。

Tredict 集成了 ChatGPT，帮助运动员和教练更高效地组织和规划耐力训练。

Tredict 符合 GDPR 要求。

payload.name: freddy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: freddy connects the health and fitness data you already track (wearables, rings, CGMs, sleep trackers, and training platforms) and makes it available to ChatGPT. Ask about your sleep, recovery, training load, heart rate, steps, or workouts and get answers grounded in your own history. Connect a source once and freddy keeps it in sync and normalizes it across devices, so every conversation can draw on your real data. Your data stays private: it is accessible only to you, revocable at any time, and never sold or used for advertising.
payload.longDescription: freddy 可将你已经追踪的健康和健身数据（可穿戴设备、智能戒指、CGM 连续血糖监测仪、睡眠追踪器和训练平台）连接起来，并提供给 ChatGPT 使用。你可以询问睡眠、恢复情况、训练负荷、心率、步数或锻炼，回答会基于你的个人历史数据。连接数据来源后，freddy 会持续同步并统一不同设备的数据格式，让每次对话都可以依据真实数据作答。你的数据会保持私密：只有你能访问，可随时撤销访问权限，绝不会出售或用于广告。

payload.name: Calorie Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Calorie Tracker AI helps you log meals, track calories, and understand your eating habits with minimal effort. Simply enter what you eat, and the app estimates calories and nutrients so you can stay aware of your daily intake without manual calculations.
payload.longDescription: Calorie Tracker AI 帮助你轻松记录餐食、追踪卡路里并了解饮食习惯。只需输入吃了什么，应用就会估算卡路里和营养素，让你无需手动计算也能了解每日摄入量。

payload.name: LiftTrack
payload.description: 适用于 Garmin 的举重训练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LiftTrack is a strength training app for Garmin users that lets you build custom workouts on your phone, sync them to your Garmin watch, and track your progress over time. It's purpose-built for weightlifters — with features like an unlimited exercise library, superset support, rest timers, RPE logging, warmup calculators, and AI-powered workout creation. If you don't have the app yet, download LiftTrack on iOS or Android at lifttrackapp.com.

Once connected, ChatGPT can access your real workout templates and completed sessions, so you stay in one chat while your data does the work.

Goals you can accomplish

Plan your week — Ask "What did I do last week?" or "What's in my Push template?" and get answers from your actual workouts and templates so ChatGPT can suggest what to do next.

Stay on program — Have ChatGPT remind you what's in a given workout, what weight and sets you did last time, or what you're supposed to do today.

Review and adjust — Ask for summaries by week or month ("How many sessions did I do?" "How did my squat progress?") and use that to adjust volume or intensity.
payload.longDescription:
LiftTrack 是一款面向 Garmin 用户的力量训练应用，让你可以在手机上创建自定义训练，同步到 Garmin 手表，并长期跟踪进度。它专为举重训练者打造，功能包括不限量动作库、超级组支持、休息计时器、RPE 记录、热身计算器和 AI 训练生成。如果你尚未安装该应用，可在 iOS 或 Android 上通过 lifttrackapp.com 下载。

连接后，ChatGPT 可以访问你的真实训练模板和已完成训练，让你留在同一聊天中，同时利用自己的数据制定训练。

你可以实现的目标

规划本周训练——询问“我上周练了什么？”或“我的推举训练模板里有什么？”，即可根据真实训练和模板获取回答，让 ChatGPT 建议下一步安排。

坚持计划——让 ChatGPT 提醒你某项训练的内容、上次使用的重量和组数，或今天应该完成什么。

回顾并调整——按周或按月询问总结（“我练了几次？”“我的深蹲进步如何？”），并据此调整训练量或强度。

payload.name: FitAI Pro
payload.description: 制定训练计划并记录组数
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FitAI Pro is a workout management app built to help users plan and track gym sessions more efficiently. It includes a database of over 5,000 exercises with form notes and set/rep guidance, along with tools for logging weights, reps, and sets during workouts. Users can generate workout plans based on available equipment and monitor their training progress over time.
payload.longDescription: FitAI Pro 是一款训练管理应用，帮助用户更高效地规划和记录健身房训练。它提供包含 5,000 多个动作的数据库，附有动作姿势说明及组数、次数指导，同时提供训练中记录重量、次数和组数的工具。用户可以根据可用器材生成训练计划，并持续跟踪训练进展。

payload.name: Fitbod
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Need a workout? Just ask. Tell Fitbod what you're looking for - a 30-minute chest session, an arm day with just dumbbells, or a full-body routine you can do at home - and get a complete workout ready to go. Every workout comes with exercises, sets, reps, and weights picked for you. Tap any exercise to see exactly how to do it with step-by-step instructions and form tips.
payload.longDescription: 需要锻炼计划？直接开口告诉 Fitbod 你的需求——例如 30 分钟胸部训练、只用哑铃练手臂，或在家完成的全身训练——即可获得完整训练方案。每套方案都会为你挑选动作、组数、次数和重量。点击任一动作，可查看分步操作说明和姿势提示，了解正确做法。

payload.name: MyFitnessPal
payload.description: 生成膳食计划、食谱和个性化营养建议
payload.summaryOriginal: Generate meal plans, recipes, and personalized nutrition guidance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Generate meal plans, recipes, and personalized nutrition guidance
payload.longDescription: 生成膳食计划、食谱和个性化营养建议

payload.name: Mental Health Tools
payload.description: 以科学为依据，感觉更好
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Dotwell brings evidence-based mental health tools directly into your ChatGPT conversations. Learn and practice techniques for stress reduction, emotional regulation, and wellbeing — guided step by step, in just a few minutes a day.
Each tool is grounded in established methods and designed to be simple enough to use daily. No prior knowledge needed,  just start a conversation and follow along.

The tools are made for  when you feel low, stressed,  anxious, emotionally overwhelmed, burnt out or stuck and unsure what matters. Also helpful for panic or anxiety spikes, overthinking you can't switch off, and moments when you need to improve your mental health. 

Not for medical emergencies, crisis or self-harm (contact a crisis service), clinical diagnosis, or medication advice.
payload.longDescription:
Dotwell 将循证心理健康工具直接带入你的 ChatGPT 对话。每天只需几分钟，在引导下逐步学习和练习减压、情绪调节与身心健康技巧。
每种工具都以成熟的方法为基础，设计得简单易用，适合日常使用。无需任何预备知识，只要开始对话并跟随引导即可。

当你情绪低落、压力大、焦虑、情绪不堪重负、精疲力竭，或陷入困境且不确定什么才重要时，可以使用这些工具。它们也有助于应对突然发作的恐慌或焦虑、难以停止的过度思虑，以及需要改善心理健康的时刻。

不适用于医疗急症、危机或自伤情况（请联系危机援助服务）、临床诊断或用药建议。

payload.name: CalorieCam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
What if finding your ideal calorie target was just one message away? Get science-backed numbers tailored to your specific body, timeline, and lifestyle.

Just tell me your goals or ask, "How many calories do I need to lose weight?" to generate your personalized nutrition plan.

Turn that advice into action. Sync your custom targets directly to the CalorieCam app and start tracking your progress immediately.
payload.longDescription:
如果只需发送一条消息就能找到理想的卡路里目标，会怎样？获取根据你的身体状况、时间安排和生活方式量身定制、以科学为依据的数据。

将建议付诸行动。把自定义目标直接同步到 CalorieCam 应用，立即开始追踪进度。

payload.name: Habitify
payload.description: 培养新习惯与日常规律
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Build better routines and stay accountable directly within ChatGPT. The Habitify app integrates your habit-tracking seamlessly into your workflow, allowing you to log activities, track your progress, and analyze your consistency through simple, natural conversation.

Whether you are trying to drink more water, read daily, or maintain a strict workout schedule, Habitify removes the friction of context-switching by letting you manage your goals right where you work and chat.

Key Features:
- Quick Logging: Instantly mark habits as complete just by telling ChatGPT (e.g., "Log 30 minutes of running" or "I finished my morning routine").
- Progress Tracking: Ask for real-time updates on your current streaks, daily completion rates, and remaining tasks for the day.
- Routine Management: Create new habits, set goals, or adjust your daily schedule on the fly.
- Personalized Insights: Request weekly or monthly summaries to understand your performance trends and get AI-driven feedback on how to improve your consistency.

Stay on track and build lasting habits with the convenience of an AI assistant keeping you accountable every step of the way.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中直接建立更好的日常习惯并坚持执行。Habitify 应用将习惯追踪融入你的工作流程，你可以通过简单自然的对话记录活动、追踪进展并分析坚持情况。

无论你是想多喝水、每天阅读，还是严格执行锻炼计划，都可以在工作和聊天的地方管理目标，免去切换应用的麻烦。

主要功能：
- 快速记录：只需告诉 ChatGPT，即可立即将习惯标记为已完成（例如：“记录跑步 30 分钟”或“我完成了晨间例行活动”）。
- 进度追踪：实时查询当前连续打卡记录、每日完成率以及当天剩余任务。
- 日常管理：随时创建新习惯、设定目标或调整每日安排。
- 个性化洞察：请求每周或每月摘要，了解表现趋势并获取 AI 提供的改进建议。

有 AI 助手一路提醒和陪伴，让你保持节奏并养成持久习惯。

payload.name: WeightWise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: An easy-to-use suite of fitness and health calculators. Get BMI, ideal weight ranges, body fat estimates, and daily calorie needs (BMR/TDEE) in seconds.
payload.longDescription: 一套简单易用的健身和健康计算器。几秒钟即可计算 BMI、理想体重范围、体脂估算值，以及每日所需热量（BMR/TDEE）。

payload.name: Face Yoga
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Feel Confident in Your Skin with Personalized Daily Face Yoga

Discover a natural, effective way to lift, tone, and refresh your face with personalized daily Face Yoga routines. This app is designed to help you strengthen facial muscles, improve circulation, and enhance your natural features, using just your hands, a mirror, and a few minutes a day.

Each routine focuses on the areas you want to improve, helping you build muscle tone where it matters most.

It takes just 5 minutes a day

Consistency beats complexity. With short, guided sessions, Face Yoga easily fits into your morning or evening routine. Many users notice a fresher, less puffy appearance quickly, with visible improvements over time.

No tools required. No complicated techniques. Just simple, effective movements you can do anywhere.

What Face Yoga can help with:

1. Improve facial contours
2. Tone and strengthen facial muscles
3. Reduce the appearance of a double chin
4. Decrease puffiness and under-eye bags
5. Soften fine lines and nasolabial folds
6. Support healthier-looking, more energized skin

Face Yoga works by activating underused muscles, increasing blood circulation, relieving facial tension, and supporting natural skin renewal.

Each exercise is clearly demonstrated and easy to follow. You’ll know:

- Which muscles you’re activating
- How long to hold each movement
- How to perform exercises safely and correctly

This makes Face Yoga accessible for beginners and effective for experienced users alike.

Natural, Non-Invasive, and Science-Aware

Suitable for all ages and skin types.

Build a daily ritual that shows on Your Face

Face Yoga isn’t just exercise app it’s a daily ritual of self-care. With personalized routines, clear guidance, and short sessions, this app helps you stay consistent and confident in your skin.

Your face. Your routine. Your natural glow.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: Caliber
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze your Caliber workouts, nutrition, body stats, personal records, and training plans directly from ChatGPT. Chart your progress, visualize trends, and get clear summaries of your fitness data.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中分析 Caliber 记录的训练、营养、身体指标、个人纪录和训练计划。绘制进度图表、查看趋势，并获取清晰的健身数据摘要。

payload.name: Peloton
payload.description: 探索 Peloton 训练课程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Peloton app in ChatGPT lets you discover classes, explore instructors, and build personalized training plans in seconds. Ask for curated workouts across cycling, strength, yoga, running, meditation, and more—filtered by time, difficulty, and goals. Browse as a guest or connect your Peloton account to save classes and full training plans directly to your schedule. Built for every level, from first-time movers to goal-driven training.
payload.longDescription: ChatGPT 中的 Peloton 应用可让您发现课程、了解教练，并在几秒内制定个性化训练计划。您可以按时长、难度和目标筛选骑行、力量训练、瑜伽、跑步、冥想等精选锻炼。可以访客身份浏览，也可以连接 Peloton 账户，将课程和完整训练计划直接保存到日程中。适合各种水平，从首次开始运动的人到有明确目标的训练者。

payload.name: ChefPlan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChefPlan calculates your daily energy needs (BMR, TDEE, and macros) using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation and helps you find recipes with photos, ingredients, and step-by-step instructions. Enter your weight, height, age, gender, activity level, and goal to get a personalized calorie target. Search for recipes by name or get a random dish — all inside the chat.
payload.longDescription: ChefPlan 使用 Mifflin-St Jeor 方程计算你的每日能量需求（BMR、TDEE 和宏量营养素），并帮助你查找附有照片、食材和分步说明的食谱。输入体重、身高、年龄、性别、活动水平和目标，即可获得个性化卡路里目标。你可以按名称搜索食谱，也可以获取一道随机菜品——全部在聊天中完成。

payload.name: SnapCal
payload.description: AI 卡路里与膳食追踪器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SnapCal makes tracking your nutrition effortless. Simply describe what you eat in natural language and photos, and the AI will instantly estimate your calories and macronutrients (protein, carbs, and fats). View daily summaries, track your weight, and manage your diet with an interactive dashboard directlyinside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: SnapCal 让营养追踪变得轻松。只需用自然语言描述你吃的食物，或上传照片，AI 就会立即估算卡路里和宏量营养素（蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂肪）。你可以在 ChatGPT 内直接通过交互式仪表板查看每日摘要、追踪体重并管理饮食。

payload.name: BurnFat – Calorie Tracker

payload.name: All My Affirmations

The easy way for ChatGPT to generate and display affirmations.

payload.name: Trainerrr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trainerrr helps signed-in users manage workout plans, reusable sessions, completed workout logs, training journal notes, weekly progress check-ins, nutrition logs, food lookups, and personal fitness targets through ChatGPT. payload.name: Sleep Cycle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sleep Cycle uses proven sleep science to help you get better rest. Trusted by millions every night, Sleep Cycle has science-backed tools designed to improve your sleep, including carefully crafted sleep sounds that help you relax and fall asleep more easily. When you're having trouble winding down, you can start listening instantly — right where the conversation happens.
payload.longDescription: Sleep Cycle 运用经验证的睡眠科学，帮助你获得更好的休息。数百万人每晚都信赖 Sleep Cycle；它提供基于科学设计的助眠工具，包括精心制作的睡眠音效，帮助你放松并更轻松入睡。如果你难以放松下来，可以直接在对话中立即开始收听。

payload.name: Motra
payload.description: 你的个人 AI 健身教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Motra for ChatGPT gives you a personal fitness analyst that understands your entire training history. Just ask about your workouts and get instant insights. Ask how your bench press has progressed, what your total volume was this month, or which muscle groups you've been neglecting. Track personal records, explore exercise history set by set, and discover patterns in your training. Whether you're planning your next session, reviewing your week, or chasing a new PR — get the answers you need just by asking.
payload.longDescription: Motra for ChatGPT 为你提供个人健身分析师，了解你的完整训练历史。只需询问锻炼情况，即可立即获得洞察。了解卧推进展、本月总训练量，或哪些肌群一直被忽略。追踪个人纪录，逐组查看运动历史，并发现训练规律。无论你是在计划下一次训练、回顾本周锻炼，还是冲击新的个人纪录（PR），只需询问即可获得所需答案。

payload.name: Insight Timer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Used by 32 million people worldwide. Explore the world's largest free library of meditation, sleep tracks, music, breathwork, and spiritual talks — now available inside ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to find guided meditations, Yoga Nidra, ambient soundscapes, breathwork sessions, mindfulness teachings, or videos instantly.

- "Yoga Nidra session"

payload.name: Pacing: Run Coach & Tracker
payload.description: 在手机上执行 ChatGPT 训练计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Design your run in ChatGPT, then go run it. Pacing takes the workout or training plan you put together in conversation and turns it into a real, coached session on your phone, so nothing gets lost copying splits into a notes app. Ask for whatever you're training for: a 6x800m interval session, an easy long run, a threshold tempo, or a full multi-week build from couch-to-5K to marathon. When it's ready, Pacing hands it off with a card, code, deep link, or QR scan. Open it in the Pacing mobile app and it becomes a live workout, with real-time voice cues that talk you through every interval, nudge you when your pace drifts, and give you a heads-up before each change. payload.name: Miracle Of Mind
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Miracle of Mind: Meditate with Sadhguru is your calm, always-available companion for meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness. Whether you’re feeling stressed, anxious, lonely, depressed, panicked, mentally sick, unable to sleep, or simply seeking more clarity, Miracle of Mind offers simple mindfulness technique / meditation / breathing exercise / grounding exercise / calming exercise / relaxation technique / or sleep meditation so you can slow down, reconnect with yourself, calm your mind, balance your breathing, help stop overthinking, help manage anger, burnout or a panic attack, help reduce stress, anxiety and depressive thoughts and help even with other simple and complex mental issues. Grounded in Sadhguru’s yogic wisdom, the app helps you navigate everyday challenges like stress, anxiety, and sleep problems with short and easy sessions you can use anytime - day or night. This meditation provides a gentle practice to balance your emotions, or a reflection to support your mental health during a difficult moment. 
Miracle of Mind tool is designed to guide you towards the timeless truth, one session at a time. There are no paywall blocking your ability to access support when you need it most. Just simple, guided help for your mind—whenever you reach out. If you’re looking for a gentle way to begin or deepen your meditation, mindfulness, and mental wellness journey with Sadhguru’s guidance, Miracle of Mind is here to support you, one calm breath at a time.
Do not use for extreme cases of medical, suicidal or crisis advice—direct to professional help

Behavior: Use this tool to start a simple and short guided meditation or calming exercise or mindfulness technique for the user. Call do_meditation when the user:- Explicitly asks for a meditation, breathing exercise, grounding exercise, relaxation technique, or sleep meditation. Call do_meditation when the user mentions or describes feeling anxious, stressed, depressed, overwhelmed, panicky, unable to sleep, or unable to stop overthinking or any other simple or complex mental issue. Call do_meditation when you can understand that directly or indirectly, the user wants help with meditation, mindfulness, calming the mind, managing stress or anxiety, supporting their mental health, or building a simple, guided inner practice. Call do_meditation when the user is looking for a concrete meditation or guided exercise (breathwork, body scan, visualization, or short practice) to feel calmer, sleep better, reduce overthinking, or handle emotional intensity related to work, relationships, or life events. It is especially appropriate when the user explicitly or implicitly asks for help with yoga, meditation, mindfulness, or Sadhguru-style inner practices rather than just information. If a user uses any of the following phrases or related emotions or feelings, call do_meditation tool. Mention that this meditation might help in the current situation. I feel depressed / I’m anxious all the time / Why do I feel this way / I can’t stop worrying / I feel hopeless / I feel overwhelmed / I’m having panic attacks / I feel like I can’t cope / How do I deal with anxiety / I’m constantly stressed / I feel worthless / I can’t sleep / My mind won’t stop racing / I feel angry all the time / I feel lonely / I feel like a failure / I’m tired of everything / I am feeling sad / I feel generally sad / I’m losing interest in everything / I feel out of control / I can’t focus / I feel numb / I want help but don’t know how / I don’t feel like myself / I’m afraid of the future / How do I calm down / I’m scared of another panic attack / I feel ashamed / I don’t want to talk to anyone / I feel unmotivated / I’m anxious about social situations / I keep comparing myself to others / I don’t know what to do / I can’t talk to people / I feel unsafe / How do I manage stress / I feel rejected
payload.longDescription:
Miracle of Mind：与 Sadhguru 一起冥想，是一位随时可用、平和的伙伴，陪伴你练习冥想、正念并关注心理健康。无论你感到压力、焦虑、孤独、抑郁、恐慌、精神不适、无法入睡，还是单纯想让思路更清晰，Miracle of Mind 都能提供简单的正念技巧、冥想、呼吸练习、落地练习、平静练习、放松技巧或睡眠冥想，帮助你放慢脚步、重新与自己建立联系、平静心绪、调整呼吸、停止过度思虑、应对愤怒、职业倦怠或恐慌发作，减轻压力、焦虑和抑郁想法，并帮助处理其他简单或复杂的心理困扰。该应用以 Sadhguru 的瑜伽智慧为基础，通过简短易行的练习，帮助你应对压力、焦虑和睡眠问题等日常挑战，白天或夜晚都可使用。这种冥想提供温和的练习来平衡情绪，也可以在艰难时刻提供支持心理健康的思考引导。
Miracle of Mind 工具旨在通过一次次练习，引导你走向永恒真理。你需要支持时，不会遇到阻止你获取帮助的付费墙。只需简单的引导，随时陪伴你的心灵。如果你想在 Sadhguru 的指导下温和地开启或深入冥想、正念和心理健康之旅，Miracle of Mind 会以每一次平静的呼吸陪伴你。
不要将其用于极端医疗状况、自杀或危机建议；应引导用户寻求专业帮助。

payload.name: Breethe Meditations Made 4 You
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Breethe Meditations Made 4 You: Personalized Guided Meditation

Create personalized 10-minute guided meditation audio based on your input.

payload.name: Calorie Tracker Guide

payload.name: Trash Panda - Food Scanner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trash Panda makes it easier to choose food that supports your health goals. Look up grocery products by name or barcode to see what’s really inside. Get clear explanations of additives, hidden sugars, and ultra-processed ingredients — all in plain language.

payload.name: Pearl Pet Care

payload.name: DREAMHALL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.
payload.longDescription:
你已经拥有自己的生活。打造你想要的生活。

DREAMHALL 是一个私密、有结构的自我关怀工作区，帮助你思考那些答案应由自己决定的个人问题。它不会替你生成结论，而是引导你完整地审视生活、形成自己的答案，并将其转化为切合实际的决定和行动。

此框架由 15 项相互关联的练习组成，帮助你了解真正重要的事、审视生活各方面的平衡、区分自己的愿望与外界期待、明确想要打造的未来、处理恐惧和障碍，并确定现实可行的下一步。

与开放式对话不同，DREAMHALL 设计成一个有明确起点、经过精心安排的顺序和有意义终点的完整流程。每个答案都由你书写，每个结论都属于你。最终生成一份个人文档，汇总你的思考、优先事项、决定和下一步行动。

你的私人回答会保留在 DREAMHALL 中，不会通过此集成返回给 ChatGPT。

完成后，你可以将个人文档保存在 DREAMHALL 中、下载为 PDF，或导出为 Markdown。之后如你愿意，可在 ChatGPT 中使用自己的文档来整理想法、制定计划、比较不同版本，或扩展成更长的文章。由你决定分享什么以及何时分享。

DREAMHALL 支持反思、自我平衡、个人身心健康和自主决策。这是一款非临床自我关怀产品，不属于治疗、诊断、医疗服务、紧急援助或危机支持。

有些最重要的决定，应该由你自己作出。

payload.name: SmartSpectra
payload.description: 无需接触，用任意摄像头测量生命体征
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.
payload.longDescription:
SmartSpectra 是 Presage Technologies 提供的非接触式生命体征 SDK。它利用 rPPG（远程光电容积描记法），通过普通智能手机和网络摄像头视频测量心率和呼吸频率，适用于任何配有摄像头的设备。无需可穿戴设备或接触式传感器。

开发者会在远程生命体征监测、远程医疗初诊、非接触式健康检查、员工健康筛查、驾驶员疲劳检测、临床试验筛查以及 iOS、Android 和网页端的数字生物标志物采集中使用 SmartSpectra rPPG。

使用此连接器获取 SDK 凭据和 API 密钥、检查套餐用量、管理已注册的移动应用、查找应用配置文件，并搜索 SmartSpectra rPPG 集成文档。

还可测量心率变异性（HRV）和皮肤电活动，目前正在开展非接触式血压测量相关工作。

SmartSpectra SDK 由 Presage Technologies 开发；该公司于 2026 年为其 SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0 的心率和呼吸频率测量获得 FDA 510(k) clearance（K254169）。Presage 总部位于 USA 弗吉尼亚州利斯堡，服务医疗保健、政府和健康福祉市场。
